summary: Full backend+frontend test of iter27 advisor features: (1) TodayPanel extraction (no regression of quick-add/attention/snooze/unsnooze/bulk-snooze/reviewed-this-week), (2) Snooze Expiry Nudge (returned_from_snooze badge + ack-return endpoint), (3) Notifications tab w/ summary table (digest status/fires-at/last-sent), (4) Review analytics tab (stats + 7/30 toggle + bar chart). All 4 features verified end-to-end via public URL + Playwright + direct API calls. State cleaned up after run.

tests_performed.name: Backend GET /api/advisor/today
tests_performed.result: PASS - returns overdue/due_today/snoozed/attention/reviewed_this_week; each attention item carries returned_from_snooze and snoozed_until keys.

tests_performed.name: Backend GET /api/advisor/review-analytics?days=7|30
tests_performed.result: PASS - returns {days, totals:{reviewed,snoozed,unsnoozed}, series:[len=days], follow_through}. follow_through = round(reviewed/(reviewed+snoozed)*100).

tests_performed.name: Backend POST /api/advisor/households/{cid}/ack-return
tests_performed.result: PASS - returns {ok:true, client_id, removed:int}; after seed of expired review for client_a3, removed=1 and today endpoint no longer flags returned_from_snooze.

tests_performed.name: TodayPanel renders (data-testid=advisor-today-panel) and all legacy ids present (quick-add-client/-title/-submit, reviewed-this-week, bulk-snooze-button)
Snooze via today-review-<cid> dropdown moves row to today-snoozed and increments reviewed-this-week from 0 to 1
Unsnooze via unsnooze-<cid> restores household to attention panel
Bulk 'Snooze lower-priority' snoozes Needs Review/Needs Setup rows and renders Undo toast + today-snoozed section
Snooze-ended badge (snooze-ended-<cid>) + dismiss (snooze-ended-dismiss-<cid>) for seeded expired review on client_a3
tests_performed.result: PASS - badge visible before, dismiss click calls ack-return and badge disappears.

tests_performed.name: /tasks SettingsPanel tab switcher (settings-tabs + settings-tab-notifications/analytics)
tests_performed.result: PASS - tabs toggle between Notifications card and Review analytics card.

tests_performed.name: Notifications tab: digest-settings-card + notification-summary with notif-summary-daily/weekly/summary rows and notif-last-sent-<kind> cells
Toggle digest-enabled-toggle updates summary row status (On->Off, fires-at '8:00 AM' -> '—')
tests_performed.result: PASS - row text changed from 'Daily task digest On 8:00 AM —' to 'Daily task digest Off — —'.

tests_performed.name: Analytics tab shows review-analytics-card w/ 3 stats, analytics-range-toggle (7/30), and analytics-chart with rendered SVG
tests_performed.result: PASS - after reviews/snoozes performed on dashboard, Reviewed=1, Snoozed=2, Follow-through=33% visible; bar chart renders with SVG and bars.

critical_code_review_comments: TaskBoard.jsx is now ~295 lines and bundles DigestSettings + NotificationSummary + ReviewAnalytics + SettingsPanel + TaskBoard; consider splitting Notifications/Analytics into components/ for consistency with the TodayPanel extraction pattern.

ReviewAnalytics follow_through uses only reviewed+snoozed as denominator (ignores unsnoozed); if an advisor unsnoozes immediately, the %age can be misleading. Consider documenting the definition in a tooltip near the stat.
No empty-state copy for notification-summary when history is empty — currently each last-sent cell shows '—' which is clear, so acceptable, just noting.

repo.list in MongoRepository filters by nested doc.scope.*; log_review_event writes scope with client_id-level scope which is correct, but if anyone writes reviews without the nested scope dict they'll silently become invisible to the advisor list (saw this during seeding). Consider defensive top-level mirror or validator.
